items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember having a record with Fred Astaire.

ctx.x: I don’t know when I started getting a few records myself. I . . . There’s a grey area there in my brain. I just can’t think what I did. I remember having a record with Fred Astaire. As I think of it now, Fred Astaire probably was quite a good singer. A lot of people . . . I’m trying to remember what it was. It was like . . . what’s that thing? “Christopher Columbus.”
Yeah, that was by Fletcher Henderson’s band.
